About Couple Better Gifts

Couple Better Gifts started as a web-business project for a BYU–Idaho class. The quiz helps you find gifts for teens and adults based on their interests and your budget.

How the quiz works

Choose a budget, tell us who you’re shopping for, and pick their interests. We’ll show a few gift ideas with shopping links and details to check before buying. All interests are available to everyone.

How we choose gifts

Each idea has a use, a budget range, and a connection to an interest. The quiz picks from a saved list. The guides cover things that can affect your purchase, such as connections, size, book editions, and extra supplies.

AI helped build the website and draft the guides. We haven’t personally tested the products. Technical details come from the manufacturer’s instructions or official game rules, linked in the guides. Check Amazon for the current price, seller, availability, and delivery date.

Shopping links and advertising

As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Some links open a specific product; others open an Amazon search. Purchases through these links may earn us a commission. The buying guides also have space for display ads.

Amazon and its sellers handle payment, shipping, returns, and order support. For help with an order, contact them through your Amazon order page.

About the project

This is an independently run student project. BYU–Idaho, Amazon, and the brands featured here have no role in running it. The site is intended for adult shoppers choosing gifts for people aged 13 and older.
